name: g_videoMode
notes: 0 CGA, 1 Tandy, 2 EGA (see g_biosVideoMode); set from argv[2] or detect_video()

name: g_cmpFiles
notes: 28 x {name, size, data, value, pos}: the .CMP picture files (sizes match the game disk); names are seg0304/tables.c's literal pool

name: g_biosVideoMode
notes: {4, 9, 0x0D}: BIOS mode per g_videoMode (CGA 320x200x4, Tandy 320x200x16, EGA 320x200x16), passed to fn_0000_14DD by main

name: g_tunes
notes: 25 far pointers to the music-driver byte streams (tune_XXXX) played through fn_0512_03CD

name: g_windows
notes: struct window[3]: text windows in cells (x, y, w, h + colours); win_x/win_y/win_w/win_h = current (1ED8-1EDE)

name: g_scriptTable
notes: far pointers to the actor scripts (docs/SCRIPTS.md)

name: g_palettes
notes: far pointers to 16-byte palettes, one per g_cmpFiles entry

name: g_groupFirst
notes: first letter index of each of the 6 letter groups (ABCD, EFG, HIJK, LMNOP, QRSTU, VWXYZ)

name: g_sprites
notes: far pointers to sprite frames cut from the *DON/*PET sheets
